parent_channels.name: Boundaries, Enclosures, and Release

subchannels.name: Sealed Threshold and Forecourt
subchannels.scene_or_process: A door is shut tightly, joining the barrier to the forecourt that controls entry.
subchannels.active_motifs: sealed door `و ص د:B001/m01`; enclosing closure `ء ص د:B001/m01`; attached forecourt or door `و ص د:B002/m01`; enclosing forecourt `ء ص د:B004/m01`; vessel stopper `ص ب ر:B018/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:20 `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` (و ص د); 90:17 `صَّبْرِ` (ص ب ر); no independent surface occurrence for ء ص د
subchannels.synthesis: Closure is both an action and a built threshold. The shut door, its forecourt, and the stopper all regulate passage by completing an aperture, giving the final fire an architectural as well as punitive enclosure.

subchannels.name: Stone Pen in the Mountain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard mountain hollow is built into a stone enclosure that holds livestock or property.
subchannels.active_motifs: stone livestock pen `و ص د:B003/m01`; containing corral `ء ص د:B002/m01`; hard gravelly stone `ص ب ر:B005/m01`; rain-holding rock hollow `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; low enclosing wall `ك ف ر:B013/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene joins natural hardness to deliberate containment: a rocky depression or mountain chamber becomes a pen whose low stone walls hold what has been gathered inside.

subchannels.name: Unfastening and Disentanglement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A knot, seal, or interlocked pair is opened and its joined parts separate.
subchannels.active_motifs: untying a knot `ح ل ل:B001/m01`; opening a sealed object `ف ك ك:B001/m01`; separating interlocked parts `ف ك ك:B001/m02`; departure from attachment `ف ك ك:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Release begins as a mechanical operation: tension is undone, a closure opens, and joined elements part. This concrete sequence supplies the action grammar behind the surah's emancipatory release.

subchannels.name: Ransom, Pledge, and Captive Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or pledged asset is freed from the bond that holds it.
subchannels.active_motifs: redemption of a pledge `ف ك ك:B002/m01`; freeing a captive or enslaved person `ف ك ك:B002/m02`; neck standing for the enslaved person `ر ق ب:B004/m02`; substitute held under guarantee `ع ق ب:B010/m01`; guarantor who remains liable `ص ب ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The captive and the collateral share a condition of being held under another's claim. Redemption removes that claim, while guarantee and substitution describe the liability that must be answered before release is complete.

subchannels.name: Sacred Limit and Lawful Exit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected limit is crossed only when prohibition, covenant, or consecrated status is released.
subchannels.active_motifs: lawful permission `ح ل ل:B003/m01`; crossing beyond a sanctuary limit `ح ل ل:B003/m02`; offering reaching its appointed place `ح ل ل:B004/m03`; sanctuary offering `ه د ي:B005/m01`; approach through devotion `ق ر ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lawfulness is spatial and procedural: the protected boundary, the consecrated offering, and its arrival at the proper place determine when restraint ends and access becomes permitted.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A boundary can seal, contain, admit, or release what is held within it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:13 `فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ` opens a bond, while 90:20 `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` closes the terminal enclosure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same boundary logic extends from doors and stone pens to bottle stoppers, sanctuary limits, pledges, and bodily joints.

parent_channels.name: Terrain, Passage, and Settlement

subchannels.name: Steep Pass and Hazardous Ascent
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler commits to a steep, projecting mountain route whose difficulty cannot be bypassed.
subchannels.active_motifs: steep mountain pass `ع ق ب:B012/m01`; covered mountain saddle `ك ف ر:B013/m01`; plunging into danger `ق ح م:B001/m01`; road peril few will undertake `ق ح م:B002/m01`; inescapable ordeal `ص ب ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The pass is both topography and ordeal. Its covered saddle and projecting rise demand entry into danger, and the lack of an easy outlet turns ascent into a sustained act rather than a single step.

subchannels.name: Elevated Road and Clear Guidance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised, visible road functions as a guide toward a chosen direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: elevated clear road `ن ج د:B001/m01`; evident guiding route `ن ج د:B002/m01`; gentle direction to road and truth `ه د ي:B001/m01`; orientation and manner of travel `ه د ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:10 `هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ` (ه د ي, ن ج د)
subchannels.synthesis: Height makes the route legible, and guidance makes it actionable. The two roads therefore combine visible terrain with directed conduct.

subchannels.name: Mountain Core, Ridge, and Named Height
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mountain is apprehended through its center, ridge, hollow, and named identity.
subchannels.active_motifs: mountain and its middle `ص ب ر:B017/m01`; central mass `ك ب د:B003/m01`; mountain hollow `ء ص د:B005/m01`; Mount Uhud `ء ح د:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:17 `صَّبْرِ` (ص ب ر); 90:4 `كَبَدٍ` (ك ب د); 90:5, 90:7 `أَحَدٌ` (ء ح د); no independent surface occurrence for ء ص د
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs give height internal structure: a central mass rises into a ridge, contains hollows, and can become a named landmark. Uhud supplies the proper-name culmination of that mountain image.

subchannels.name: Inhabited Land and Stable Dwelling
subchannels.scene_or_process: People descend into a bounded place, inhabit it, and become its settled residents.
subchannels.active_motifs: bounded land or town `ب ل د:B001/m01`; alighting and settling `ح ل ل:B002/m01`; inhabiting a home `س ك ن:B002/m01`; dwelling site or layer `س ك ن:B009/m01`; place and established position `ك و ن:B002/m01`; remaining in the town `ب ل د:B009/m01`; resident inhabitant `ن ج د:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Settlement is a sequence of arrival, location, residence, and persistence. A bounded site becomes a social place when descent into it is followed by inhabitation and continued presence across its dwellings or layers.

subchannels.name: Wilderness, Remoteness, and Disorientation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or nomad moves through remote waste, circles without direction, and risks destruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: uninhabited wilderness `ب ل د:B001/m02`; remote village, grave, or cut-off place `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; deadly waste or chasm `ه ل ك:B006/m01`; desert traveler without driver `ق ح م:B006/m01`; circling in bewilderment `ه ل ك:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Outside settled land, movement loses its markers. The undriven desert passage, circling bewilderment, and remote cut-off place form a coherent scene of exposure without orientation.

subchannels.name: Ground Contact, Burial, and Staying Put
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodies, basins, and residents lower themselves to the earth and remain attached to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: soil and dust `ت ر ب:B001/m01`; grave within bounded land `ب ل د:B001/m03`; grave sides `ص ب ر:B004/m03`; striking or clinging to ground `ب ل د:B010/m01`; staying and adhering `ل ب د:B003/m01`; camel breast lowered in kneeling `ب ل د:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Grounding ranges from habitation to burial and animal posture, but the operation remains the same: descent ends in sustained contact with earth, while the grave's sides define the final bounded space.

subchannels.name: Small-Vessel Passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A small attendant boat is stabilized and steered alongside a larger journey.
subchannels.active_motifs: small tender or skiff `ق ر ب:B011/m01`; rudder that stills the vessel `س ك ن:B008/m01`; travel equipment for repeated encampment `ح ل ل:B013/m01`; movement toward a needed destination `ن ج د:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The tender, rudder, and portable gear form a complete mobility scene: a small craft carries immediate needs while controlled steering keeps passage from becoming drift.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Land is organized by routes, heights, habitations, and dangerous spaces that shape movement and staying.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the `بَلَد` of 90:1-2, the two `نَّجْدَيْنِ` of 90:10, and the `عَقَبَة` of 90:11-12 form an explicit geography of settlement and ascent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Terrain also reaches graves, mountain hollows, nomadic disorientation, ground-hugging basins, travel gear, and a small attendant boat.

parent_channels.name: Perception, Signs, and Surveillance

subchannels.name: Direct Sight and Eyewitness Knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: An eye encounters an object or a facing group directly and converts mutual visibility into certain knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeing eye `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; eyewitness encounter `ع ي ن:B002/m01`; sensory sight `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; mutually visible facing groups `ر ء ي:B004/m01`; noticing by sight or hearing `ء ن س:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from organ to encounter to cognition. Direct or reciprocal visibility is not merely optical; it is the basis for certainty that an act or opposing group has been witnessed.

subchannels.name: Protective Eye and Harmful Gaze
subchannels.scene_or_process: The gaze either keeps a person under care or inflicts injury through hostile attention.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective and honoring eye `ع ي ن:B003/m01`; evil-eye injury `ع ي ن:B004/m01`; guarding accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; vigilant guard `ر ق ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Attention is ethically reversible. The same focused gaze can preserve, honor, and guard, or become an assault that damages what it fixes upon.

subchannels.name: Pupil, Mirror, and Reflected Person
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person appears as a small image in the pupil or as a visible form in a mirror.
subchannels.active_motifs: human image in the pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; mirror and facial appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m01`; wide-eyed beauty `ع ي ن:B016/m01`; visible form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reflection miniaturizes the human form without losing recognizability. Pupil, mirror, face, and formed appearance make seeing a scene in which the observer also receives an image of a person.

subchannels.name: Scout, Spy, and Lookout
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer occupies a vantage, gathers news, and protects a group through advance warning.
subchannels.active_motifs: waiting surveillance `ر ق ب:B001/m01`; guard or scout `ر ق ب:B002/m01`; elevated lookout `ر ق ب:B003/m01`; spy or advance observer `ع ي ن:B005/m01`; seeking news `ح س ب:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The role map is complete: a lookout occupies height, watches and waits, then returns intelligence that allows the guarded community to act.

subchannels.name: Visible Sign, Banner, and Beacon
subchannels.scene_or_process: A conspicuous object is raised or illuminated so a group can recognize identity and direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible sign or grouped letters `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; raised flag `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; raptor-shaped banner `ع ق ب:B013/m02`; road beacon or tower `ن و ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sign, flag, and beacon share deliberate visibility. Each concentrates meaning into a form placed where it can orient collective attention.

subchannels.name: Dream, Apparition, and Bodily Indicator
subchannels.scene_or_process: An otherwise hidden state becomes legible through a dream, apparition, stain, or bodily change.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream image `ر ء ي:B003/m01`; appearing jinn companion `ر ء ي:B008/m01`; menstrual indicator `ر ء ي:B007/m01`; visible animal pregnancy `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; eye-like notch or mark `ع ي ن:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: These are diagnostic appearances rather than ordinary objects of sight. Each visible token points beyond itself to sleep, spirit presence, bodily cycle, pregnancy, or hidden structure.

subchannels.name: Disclosure and Target Appraisal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something is deliberately shown, recognized, and assessed before action.
subchannels.active_motifs: causing another to see `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; knowledge and instruction `د ر ي:B001/m01`; eye's appraisal of size or worth `ق ح م:B007/m01`; intentional targeting of a person's sign `ء ي ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Disclosure makes an object available for judgment; appraisal then estimates its scale or value, and targeting converts that estimate into directed attention.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception turns visible forms into knowledge, protection, warning, or public evidence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:7 asks whether anyone saw, 90:8 names the two eyes, and 90:19 names denied signs.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Perception extends to spies, mirrors, evil-eye injury, dreams, menstrual and gestational signs, banners, and target appraisal.

parent_channels.name: Speech, Reputation, and Discursive Action

subchannels.name: Tongue, Lips, and Face-to-Face Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath and articulation pass through tongue and lips into spoken address between persons.
subchannels.active_motifs: organ of speech `ل س ن:B001/m01`; lips `ش ف ه:B001/m01`; mouth-to-mouth address `ش ف ه:B002/m01`; spoken utterance `ق و ل:B001/m01`; tongue as speech instrument `ق و ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:9 `لِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ` (ل س ن, ش ف ه); 90:6 `يَقُولُ` (ق و ل)
subchannels.synthesis: The channel assembles the speaker's apparatus, the produced utterance, and the interpersonal setting in which speech passes directly from one mouth to another.

subchannels.name: Eloquence, Verbal Attack, and Silencing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A skilled tongue presses an argument or attack until injury or cutting removes its force.
subchannels.active_motifs: eloquence and argumentative fluency `ل س ن:B003/m01`; verbal assault `ل س ن:B002/m01`; prolific speaker `ق و ل:B003/m01`; cutting the tongue-tip `ل س ن:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech is treated as an exercised capacity that can dominate a contest. The cut tongue supplies the bodily reversal of that power: articulation is stopped at its instrument.

subchannels.name: Message Relay and Shared Language
subchannels.scene_or_process: A message is carried through a language and delivered from one person to another.
subchannels.active_motifs: language and verbal message `ل س ن:B006/m01`; relaying a message `ل س ن:B008/m01`; reciprocal counsel `و ص ي:B003/m01`; circulating speech `ق و ل:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Language supplies the code, relay supplies transmission, and reciprocal counsel supplies the social network. Speech becomes a durable relation rather than a single utterance.

subchannels.name: Reputation, Praise, and Ostentation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conduct becomes visible talk, producing either earned praise or performative display.
subchannels.active_motifs: good public mention `ش ف ه:B004/m01`; speech circulating among people `ق و ل:B007/m01`; action performed to be seen `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; inherited honor and memorable deeds `ح س ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Public standing is produced by a loop between action, visibility, and retelling. Praise records recognized worth, while ostentation tries to manufacture the same outcome by staging the act for observers.

subchannels.name: Fabrication, Attribution, and Appropriated Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Words are invented, falsely assigned, or pulled into a speaker's possession.
subchannels.active_motifs: fabricated discourse `خ ل ق:B007/m01`; false attribution of words `ق و ل:B005/m01`; appropriating a saying `ق و ل:B006/m01`; generated or coined expression `و ل د:B005/m02`; falling into a valley of falsehood `ه ل ك:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Authorship is the contested object. Fabrication creates what was not said, false attribution assigns it to another, and appropriation draws existing speech into one's own claim; the valley image gives continued falsehood a path into which the speaker falls.

subchannels.name: Negotiation, Rule, and Formal Position
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties exchange statements until a ruling, doctrine, or definition fixes the matter.
subchannels.active_motifs: negotiation `ق و ل:B009/m01`; imposing a ruling `ق و ل:B010/m01`; doctrinal position `ق و ل:B013/m01`; signification `ق و ل:B014/m01`; formal definition `ق و ل:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Discursive action progresses from bargaining to determination. A position may become a doctrine, a sign may be read as speaking, and a definition closes the exchange by fixing a conceptual boundary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:6 foregrounds saying, 90:9 names tongue and lips, and 90:17 depicts reciprocal counsel.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.

parent_channels.name: Question, Reference, and Language Form

subchannels.name: Interrogative Selection and Requested Answer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker selects an unknown referent and asks the addressee to identify or state it.
subchannels.active_motifs: interrogative and selective `أي` `ء ي ي:B004/m01`; compound `ماذا` question `ذ و و:B004/m01`; interrogative `ها` replacing alif `ه ا ء:B004/m01`; attention-seeking `أرأيتك` `ر ء ي:B013/m01`; inquiry that elicits knowledge `د ر ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:19 `ءَايَٰتِنَا` (ء ي ي); 90:14 `ذِي`, 90:15-16 `ذَا` (ذ و و); 90:7 `يَرَهُ` (ر ء ي); 90:12 `أَدْرَىٰكَ` (د ر ي); interrogative frames at 90:5, 90:7, 90:12; related `هَٰذَا` at 90:1-2 (ه ا ء)
subchannels.synthesis: Selection, attention, and requested knowledge form one discourse event: the speaker isolates a matter, turns the addressee toward it, and demands an answer.

subchannels.name: Demonstrative and Pronominal Pointing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A form points to a present or conceptual object and anchors a pronoun to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: demonstrative `ذا` `ذ و و:B003/m01`; pronoun support `إيا` `ء ي ي:B005/m01`; relative connector `ذو` `ذ و و:B002/m01`; attention-opening `ها` `ه ا ء:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pointing is assembled from an alert, a deictic center, and a referring form. Together they bring an object into shared attention and maintain its grammatical identity.

subchannels.name: Temporal and Quantitative Question
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inquiry asks either when an event will occur or how many instances are involved.
subchannels.active_motifs: temporal `أيان` `ء ي ي:B006/m01`; large-number `كأين` `ء ي ي:B007/m01`; duration rather than calendar day `ي و م:B002/m01`; counted unit `ء ح د:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Time and quantity are parallel unknowns. Both require a bounded unit, then open that unit to questions of occurrence, duration, or multiplicity.

subchannels.name: Vocative, Response, and Explanation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call gains attention, receives an answer, and is followed by an explanatory reformulation.
subchannels.active_motifs: near or distant vocative `ء ي ي:B008/m01`; answering or answering a call `ه ا ء:B003/m01`; explanatory `أي` `ء ي ي:B009/m01`; handover command `ها` `ه ا ء:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:19 `ءَايَٰتِنَا` (ء ي ي); related deictic `هَٰذَا` at 90:1-2 (ه ا ء)
subchannels.synthesis: The discourse sequence is call, response, clarification, and transfer. It turns attention into an exchange in which meaning or an object is handed to the addressee.

subchannels.name: Letter, Sound, and Poetic Alternation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is analyzed into a named letter, arranged into verse, and governed by alternating metrical positions.
subchannels.active_motifs: letter-name `هاء` `ه ا ء:B006/m01`; lip-formed letters `ش ف ه:B001/m02`; poetic exchange of praise or satire `ه د ي:B011/m01`; metrical alternation `ر ق ب:B014/m01`; poet-name Labid `ل ب د:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Language becomes an explicit craft: articulation supplies phonetic material, meter regulates alternation, and poetic exchange directs the finished speech toward another person.

subchannels.name: Personal and Place Names
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ordinary lexical forms become proper names that identify a person, poet, mountain, or locality.
subchannels.active_motifs: Jacob as a personal name `ع ق ب:B014/m01`; poet-name Labid `ل ب د:B008/m01`; Mount Uhud `ء ح د:B006/m01`; localities named Yathrib, Turba, or Turban `ت ر ب:B008/m01`; al-Ja'la as a place name `ج ع ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Proper naming fixes reference by attaching a lexical form to one recognized bearer. The same operation identifies individuals, authored speech, a mountain, and inhabited places.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Language directs attention by selecting a referent, opening a question, locating it in time, or marking the form of address.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; interrogative framing appears at 90:5, 90:7, and 90:12, demonstrative `هَٰذَا` at 90:1-2, and relational `ذِي/ذَا` at 90:14-16.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network reaches pronoun supports, vocatives, explanatory particles, alphabetic names, oath-openers, and poetic meter.

parent_channels.name: Creation, Form, and Transformation

subchannels.name: Measured Design and Creation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing is measured, designed, and then brought into existence.
subchannels.active_motifs: prior measuring and design `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; originating creation `خ ل ق:B002/m01`; making or producing `ج ع ل:B001/m01`; bounded measure and term `ق د ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Creation is not an unstructured event. Measure supplies proportion, design supplies intelligible form, and making realizes what was first delimited.

subchannels.name: Outward Form and Inward Character
subchannels.scene_or_process: A formed body presents a visible shape while carrying an inward disposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: complete visible form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`; inward character `خ ل ق:B004/m01`; robust coarse physique `ب ل د:B008/m01`; body's protruding middle `ك ب د:B006/m01`; short stout build with obstinate character `ج ع ل:B012/m01`; closely joined bodily build `ط ع م:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Form has two registers: the body's proportions and the character expressed through conduct. Robustness, stoutness, joined bodily structure, prominence, and obstinacy show how visible physique and attributed disposition can be described together.

subchannels.name: Aptitude and Receptivity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or material is disposed toward an action and either receives or resists correction.
subchannels.active_motifs: readiness or worthiness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`; capacity to receive reform `ط ع م:B008/m02`; dull weakness `ه د ي:B009/m01`; loose, incoherent judgment `ف ك ك:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Aptitude is a latent fit between a person and a task. Receptive judgment can be shaped by correction, while dullness and loosened judgment mark failure of that fit.

subchannels.name: Transformation, Commencement, and Generated Result
subchannels.scene_or_process: An existing thing is put into a new state, begins an action, and produces a derived outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: transforming into a condition `ج ع ل:B002/m01`; beginning or persisting in action `ج ع ل:B004/m01`; occurrence in time `ك و ن:B001/m01`; generated outcome `و ل د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Change is presented as a process rather than a static label: transformation establishes a condition, commencement sustains its operation, and generation names what emerges from it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Making moves from measure and design through embodied form to changed state and generated result.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:4 names creation, 90:8 names making, and 90:3 names generation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Formation includes inward character, aptitude, generated language, smooth stone, and the persistence implied by "beginning to do."

parent_channels.name: Birth, Descent, and Life Stage

subchannels.name: Parent, Offspring, and Posterity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parents generate offspring who remain as descendants after them.
subchannels.active_motifs: offspring `و ل د:B001/m01`; father and mother as parents `و ل د:B002/m01`; surviving descendants `ع ق ب:B004/m01`; kinship by descent `ق ر ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Generation establishes a line rather than an isolated birth. Parentage creates the child, descent carries that relation forward, and posterity preserves it beyond the first generation.

subchannels.name: Womb, Delivery, and Postpartum Pain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fetus develops in the womb, while bodily closure or loosening governs whether approaching delivery can occur and what pain follows it.
subchannels.active_motifs: womb as container of offspring `ر ح م:B003/m01`; imperforate reproductive closure likened to smooth rock `خ ل ق:B012/m01`; body loosening around birth `ف ك ك:B007/m02`; occurrence of birth `و ل د:B003/m01`; nearness of delivery `ق ر ب:B012/m01`; postpartum uterine pain `ر ح م:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene follows a reproductive sequence of containment, bodily opening, approaching term, delivery, and aftermath. Imperforate closure supplies the obstructed contrast to the loosening required for birth.

subchannels.name: Newborn Dependency and Lost Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newly born child depends on a caregiver and becomes exposed when that protecting parent is lost.
subchannels.active_motifs: newborn child or young dependent `و ل د:B004/m01`; orphaned child `ي ت م:B001/m01`; protective accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; delayed care reaching the orphan `ي ت م:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Dependency gives orphanhood its social force. The newborn needs accompaniment, and the orphan is defined by the interruption or delay of that care.

subchannels.name: Age Peers and Maturing Companionship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those born in the same period grow as peers, and a son matures until he can accompany his father.
subchannels.active_motifs: age peers raised together `ت ر ب:B004/m01`; coeval by birth `و ل د:B006/m01`; son reaching companionable adulthood `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; noble full siblings `ع ي ن:B015/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Shared age becomes shared social capacity. Peers mature together, while the child-parent relation changes when the son can stand beside the father as a companion.

subchannels.name: Old Age, Childlessness, and Spousal Solitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aging can end in frailty, lack of surviving children, or a woman left without a spouse.
subchannels.active_motifs: decrepit old age `ق ح م:B004/m01`; old man recalling former life `ك و ن:B005/m01`; parent without surviving child `ر ق ب:B008/m01`; woman without spouse `ي ت م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The late-life scene is defined by altered dependency and absence. Physical decline is compounded when descendants or a spouse no longer sustain the household relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is organized by parentage, delivery, dependency, maturation, aging, and loss of caregivers.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:3 names parent and offspring, while 90:15 names the orphan.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The life-course network includes postpartum pain, near birth, age peers, a son becoming his father's companion, precocious animal aging, widowhood, and childlessness.

parent_channels.name: Kinship, Household, and Companionship

subchannels.name: Kinship and Womb-Tie
subchannels.scene_or_process: Near relatives recognize and maintain a relation grounded in common descent.
subchannels.active_motifs: kinship tie `ر ح م:B002/m01`; near relative `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; possessor or person characterized by relation `ذ و و:B001/m01`; compassion toward kin `ر ح م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:17 `مَرْحَمَةِ` (ر ح م); 90:15 `ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ` (ذ و و, ق ر ب)
subchannels.synthesis: Biological relation becomes a social obligation through recognition and compassion. The relational `ذو` construction identifies the person by the tie that calls care into action.

subchannels.name: Marriage and Cohabiting Household
subchannels.scene_or_process: Spouses enter a shared dwelling and become each other's household companions.
subchannels.active_motifs: husband and wife as cohabitants `ح ل ل:B006/m01`; household residents `س ك ن:B003/m01`; bride delivered to her spouse `ه د ي:B006/m01`; marital approach `ق ر ب:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Marriage is rendered as movement into shared place: the bride is brought, approach becomes intimacy, and co-residence establishes a household.

subchannels.name: Confidant, Solace, and Intimate Company
subchannels.scene_or_process: A chosen companion removes estrangement and becomes a trusted source of comfort.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship that removes loneliness `ء ن س:B003/m01`; intimate confidant `ء ن س:B006/m02`; continuing companion `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; object or person in whom the soul rests `س ك ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Intimacy is a change of state from estrangement to repose. The companion is not merely adjacent but actively makes the other feel settled.

subchannels.name: Cohort, Sibling, and Present Community
subchannels.scene_or_process: Peers, siblings, and present household members constitute a visible social body.
subchannels.active_motifs: coeval cohort `ت ر ب:B004/m01`; full siblings `ع ي ن:B015/m02`; people presently assembled `ع ي ن:B017/m01`; human community opposed to wildness `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Community becomes perceptible through shared age, shared parentage, and shared presence. These relations turn separate persons into an identifiable cohort.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social proximity is created by descent, co-residence, chosen intimacy, and shared group membership.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:15 names near kin, 90:17 commands mercy, and 90:18-19 names companion-groups.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Companionship reaches marriage, household inhabitants, confidants, comforting objects, noble siblings, and present witnesses.

parent_channels.name: Wealth, Provision, and Deprivation

subchannels.name: Accumulated Wealth and Dense Abundance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property is acquired and amassed until it appears as a compact pile or crowd.
subchannels.active_motifs: acquisition and abundance of wealth `م و ل:B001/m01`; wealth piled densely `ل ب د:B002/m01`; prosperity figured as abundant soil `ت ر ب:B003/m01`; present capital `ع ي ن:B011/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:6 `مَالًا لُّبَدًا` (م و ل, ل ب د); 90:16 `مَتْرَبَةٍ` (ت ر ب); 90:8 `عَيْنَيْنِ` (ع ي ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Abundance is given both economic and spatial form. Wealth becomes present capital, then accumulates visibly as material laid layer upon layer.

subchannels.name: Livelihood, Wage, and Hospitality
subchannels.scene_or_process: Work or productive property yields income that can sustain a household and host others.
subchannels.active_motifs: livelihood and hospitality revenue `ط ع م:B004/m01`; wage assigned for work `ج ع ل:B005/m01`; sufficiency and adequate provision `ح س ب:B003/m01`; repeated requests that deplete supplies `ش ف ه:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Provision has an acquisition side and a distribution side. Wage and productive income create sufficiency; hospitality and repeated demand test how long that sufficiency lasts.

subchannels.name: Feeding During Famine
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is deliberately transferred to a hungry person during a severe day of scarcity.
subchannels.active_motifs: feeding another `ط ع م:B002/m01`; hunger with exhaustion `س غ ب:B001/m01`; severe event or day `ي و م:B003/m01`; distress and constriction `ن ج د:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:14 `إِطْعَٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ` (ط ع م, ي و م, س غ ب); 90:10 `ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ` (ن ج د)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene joins need, timing, and response. Feeding matters because famine has turned an ordinary day into a constricted event in which the recipient cannot secure food unaided.

subchannels.name: Appetite, Food Heap, and Competition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is amassed, approached by appetite, and contested by those pressing toward it.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating and tasting `ط ع م:B001/m01`; piled provisions `ص ب ر:B011/m02`; ravenous competition `ه ل ك:B012/m01`; dense crowding `ل ب د:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The prepared food heap becomes the center of a social pressure field. Appetite draws bodies inward, and abundance can paradoxically produce crowding and rivalry.

subchannels.name: Poverty, Dust, and Dependence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loss of means lowers a person toward the ground and forces dependence on others.
subchannels.active_motifs: poverty figured as clinging to dust `ت ر ب:B002/m01`; destitution and abasement `س ك ن:B006/m01`; petitioner seeking a sponsor `ه ل ك:B004/m01`; having neither little nor much `ل ب د:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:16 `مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ` (س ك ن, ت ر ب); 90:6 `أَهْلَكْتُ`, `لُّبَدًا` (ه ل ك, ل ب د)
subchannels.synthesis: Poverty is embodied as lowered posture, bare ground, and absent property. Dependence follows because the destitute person must seek the sustaining relation no longer supplied by possessions.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material life moves between accumulation, livelihood, feeding, hunger, and the loss of means.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:6 names spent wealth, 90:14 feeding in famine, and 90:16 the destitute person in dust.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Provision includes wages, hospitality revenue, food heaps, relentless demand, animal appetite, and the idiom of possessing neither hair nor felt.

parent_channels.name: Trust, Liability, and Legal Continuity

subchannels.name: Security, Trust, and Entrustment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fear is stilled because a reliable person guards what has been entrusted.
subchannels.active_motifs: security and trustworthy custody `ء م ن:B001/m01`; guarding accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; guardian or watchman `ر ق ب:B002/m01`; guarantor's continuing presence `ص ب ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Trust is operational rather than merely emotional: custody is accepted, guarding continues, and a responsible person remains answerable for the entrusted object or person.

subchannels.name: Debt, Term, and Due Penalty
subchannels.scene_or_process: A debt, right, offering, or penalty reaches the point at which it must be discharged.
subchannels.active_motifs: debt or right becoming due `ح ل ل:B004/m01`; fixed amount and term `ق د ر:B001/m01`; penalty following an offense `ع ق ب:B007/m01`; final consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Liability matures through time. Measure fixes the obligation, arrival at its term makes it due, and consequence or penalty follows if the claim remains unanswered.

subchannels.name: Surety, Substitute, and Payment Hold
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guarantor or substitute stands in place of another while goods or payment remain held.
subchannels.active_motifs: personal surety `ص ب ر:B003/m01`; substitute and warranty `ع ق ب:B010/m01`; standing as another's guarantor `ك و ن:B003/m01`; redemption of collateral `ف ك ك:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Substitution redistributes risk without dissolving it. The guarantor carries the claim until payment, delivery, or redemption releases the held property.

subchannels.name: Testament, Executor, and Aftermath
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's instruction is connected to an executor who carries it beyond the speaker's death.
subchannels.active_motifs: testament and appointed executor `و ص ي:B002/m01`; continuing connection `و ص ي:B001/m01`; aftermath and outcome `ع ق ب:B006/m01`; remaining trace `ع ق ب:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A testament is speech designed to survive its source. The executor provides continuity, while aftermath and remaining trace describe the world in which the instruction must still operate.

subchannels.name: Survivorship, Inheritance, and Capital
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property passes to survivors, descendants, or collateral heirs and is distinguished as principal capital.
subchannels.active_motifs: survivorship gift `ر ق ب:B005/m01`; collateral inheritance `ر ق ب:B013/m01`; descendant or successor `ر ق ب:B015/m01`; choice property `ر ق ب:B012/m01`; present cash `ع ي ن:B011/m01`; credit sale `ع ي ن:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The legal scene follows assets across time and form: a gift is conditioned on survival, inheritance identifies the next holder, and exchange distinguishes present principal from deferred credit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social and economic obligations persist through trust, debt, guarantee, testament, inheritance, and exchange.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:13 gives the release of a bound person, and 90:17 gives trusted belief and reciprocal injunction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Obligation extends to survivorship gifts, collateral inheritance, delayed payment, ready cash, credit sales, and the "neck" or principal of property.

parent_channels.name: Counsel, Endurance, Mercy, and Protection

subchannels.name: Reciprocal Counsel
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members of a community repeatedly direct one another toward conduct they must sustain together.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal injunction `و ص ي:B003/m01`; message relay `ل س ن:B008/m01`; negotiated discussion `ق و ل:B009/m01`; continuing companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Counsel is a circulating social process. Advice is voiced, relayed, considered with others, and maintained by companions who remain present to one another.

subchannels.name: Patience, Stillness, and Composure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person restrains panic and remains steady through a condition that invites agitation or retreat.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding the self from distress `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; stillness after movement `س ك ن:B001/m01`; calm bearing without flight `ه د ي:B010/m01`; ordeal with no easy outlet `ص ب ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Patience is embodied as regulated motion. The self does not scatter, the body does not flee, and composure maintains direction inside an inescapable trial.

subchannels.name: Mercy and Protective Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: Compassion recognizes another's vulnerability and acts to preserve that person.
subchannels.active_motifs: tenderness and beneficent mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; sincere concern for a matter or person `ق و ل:B015/m01`; protective accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; guarding and preservation `ر ق ب:B002/m01`; trusted security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Mercy becomes concrete through sincere concern, presence, and guarding. Feeling for another leads to accompaniment, and accompaniment creates the security in which the vulnerable person can remain safe.

subchannels.name: Correction, Neglect, and Relapse
subchannels.scene_or_process: Counsel attempts to correct a person who may neglect the task, resist reform, or turn back after beginning.
subchannels.active_motifs: receptivity to correction `ط ع م:B008/m02`; negligence and shortfall `ي ت م:B003/m01`; retreat on the heel `ع ق ب:B003/m01`; reciprocal counsel `و ص ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reform is a contested transition. Advice meets a recipient whose response may be receptive, negligent, or a reversal back along the path already entered.

subchannels.name: Exertion, Sweat, and Exhaustion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worker or traveler undertakes a severe task, sweats under effort or fear, and expends strength until exhaustion.
subchannels.active_motifs: hardship and sustained struggle `ك ب د:B002/m01`; sweat from labor, distress, or fear `ن ج د:B006/m01`; self-expenditure to exhaustion `ه ل ك:B009/m01`; road peril few will undertake `ق ح م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Endurance is legible through bodily cost. Difficulty demands continued effort, sweat registers that effort, and exhaustion marks the point at which the task or road has consumed the traveler's available strength.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Vulnerable persons and difficult actions are sustained through reciprocal instruction, self-command, compassion, and protective presence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:17 joins belief to mutual counsel in patience and mercy.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Care appears as a companion who removes fear, a guarantor who stays, a warning against relapse, and a guard who preserves another through watchfulness.

parent_channels.name: Belief, Oath, and Ritual

subchannels.name: Assent, Doctrine, and Denial
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition is inwardly assented to as truth or rejected despite its signs.
subchannels.active_motifs: settled assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; denial and concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; attributing unbelief to another `ك ف ر:B006/m01`; doctrinal position `ق و ل:B013/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:17 `ءَامَنُوا` (ء م ن); 90:19 `كَفَرُوا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا` (ك ف ر, ء ي ي); 90:6 `يَقُولُ` (ق و ل)
subchannels.synthesis: Belief and denial are opposing responses to a meaningful sign. Doctrine gives the response an articulated form, assent or rejection locates it in the heart, and accusation assigns that rejected status to another person.

subchannels.name: Ingratitude and Disavowal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A benefit or affiliation is first received, then denied, repudiated, or treated as though it carried no claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: covering a benefit with ingratitude `ك ف ر:B004/m01`; disavowing an affiliation `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; destruction through misuse `ه ل ك:B001/m01`; public claim of expenditure `ق و ل:B007/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:19 `كَفَرُوا` (ك ف ر); 90:6 `أَهْلَكْتُ`, `يَقُولُ` (ه ل ك, ق و ل)
subchannels.synthesis: Disavowal breaks the expected relation between benefit and acknowledgment. The act may consume what was given while speech attempts to control how that consumption is publicly understood.

subchannels.name: Oath, Testimony, and Sworn Right Hand
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker invokes an oath and binds the truth of a statement to sworn testimony.
subchannels.active_motifs: sworn oath `ق س م:B004/m01`; oath by the right hand `ي م ن:B003/m01`; oath-opening affirmation `ء ي ي:B010/m01`; allotted oaths in a blood claim `ق س م:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Oath speech creates a binding relation between speaker, claim, and consequence. The right hand and distributed testimony give that relation bodily and communal form.

subchannels.name: Oath Release and Expiation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding oath or fault is discharged by a prescribed act that covers and removes its claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: token act releasing an oath `ح ل ل:B005/m01`; expiation that erases wrongdoing `ك ف ر:B009/m01`; penalty following breach `ع ق ب:B007/m01`; right-hand obligation `ي م ن:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Release does not deny that a bond existed. A specified act answers the oath or fault, preventing its punitive consequence by satisfying the outstanding claim.

subchannels.name: Prayer Response and Amen
subchannels.scene_or_process: A supplication is voiced, answered, and affirmed with a formula requesting fulfillment.
subchannels.active_motifs: saying amen for response `ء م ن:B003/m01`; answering a caller `ه ا ء:B003/m01`; vocative call `ء ي ي:B008/m01`; gift offered in affection `ه د ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:17 `ءَامَنُوا` (ء م ن); 90:19 `ءَايَٰتِنَا` (ء ي ي); 90:10 `هَدَيْنَٰهُ` (ه د ي); related `هَٰذَا` at 90:1-2 (ه ا ء)
subchannels.synthesis: The ritual exchange has a caller, an answer, and an affirming formula. The gift motif extends the same reciprocal movement from spoken request to tangible offering.

subchannels.name: Sacrifice and Nearness
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offering is selected, brought toward the sanctuary, and presented as an act of devotion.
subchannels.active_motifs: sanctuary offering `ه د ي:B005/m01`; devotional approach and sacrifice `ق ر ب:B005/m01`; offering reaching its appointed place `ح ل ل:B004/m03`; release from consecrated status `ح ل ل:B003/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Ritual nearness is a directed journey. The offering moves toward a protected place, arrives at its due location, and thereby completes the devotional act.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Commitment is expressed through assent, sworn speech, expiation, responsive prayer, and offerings brought near.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:1 opens with an oath, 90:17 names belief, and 90:19 names denial of signs.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ritual commitment reaches oath-release by a token act, "amen" as an answering formula, camouflaged sin erased by covering, and the offering's arrival at its lawful place.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Capacity, and Deliberation

subchannels.name: Counting and Reckoning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Units are counted and brought into an account that can be reviewed.
subchannels.active_motifs: counting and reckoning `ح س ب:B001/m01`; bounded amount and term `ق د ر:B001/m01`; single counted unit `ء ح د:B003/m01`; day as a countable span `ي و م:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Counting creates accountability by turning acts and durations into bounded units. Measure fixes their limits so that reckoning can compare what was claimed with what occurred.

subchannels.name: Approximation, Proportion, and Fit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing is judged by how nearly it fills a measure, occupies a middle range, or fits its intended form.
subchannels.active_motifs: approximate amount or fullness `ق ر ب:B016/m01`; medium quality `ق ر ب:B016/m02`; proportionate fit `ق د ر:B006/m01`; distributed share `ق س م:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Approximation is not vagueness but measured nearness to a target. Fit, quality, fullness, and allotted share all compare an actual object with an implicit standard.

subchannels.name: Power, Ability, and Ownership
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person possesses sufficient control to perform an act or hold property.
subchannels.active_motifs: effective power and possession `ق د ر:B003/m01`; ability to accomplish a task `ط ع م:B011/m01`; strength and enforceable right `ي م ن:B004/m01`; choice property `ر ق ب:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity joins agency to control over resources. The person can act because power, right, and property are available to be exercised.

subchannels.name: Constriction and Reduced Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Resources or room for action are narrowed to a small, difficult measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: constricted provision `ق د ر:B004/m01`; distress and tightness `ن ج د:B005/m01`; poverty and weakness `س ك ن:B006/m01`; hunger with exhaustion `س غ ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Constraint is the negative image of capacity. Provision shrinks, distress occupies the remaining space, and hunger makes the loss of practical options bodily.

subchannels.name: Planning, Opinion, and Deliberation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person moves from uncertain supposition through gathered experience and comparison toward a formed intention.
subchannels.active_motifs: uncertain supposition `ح س ب:B002/m01`; saying construed as supposition `ق و ل:B011/m01`; experience acquired through time `ن ج د:B010/m01`; reflective planning `ق د ر:B005/m01`; divided attention among alternatives `ق س م:B006/m01`; reasoned opinion `ر ء ي:B002/m01`; practical oversight `ح س ب:B006/m01`; inner unspoken thought `ق و ل:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Deliberation moves from uncertainty toward commitment. Experience, perception, and inner speech supply possible courses, divided attention compares them, and planning converts judgment into a prepared intention.

subchannels.name: Sufficiency and Universal Scope
subchannels.scene_or_process: A statement tests whether something is enough or whether any possible person falls within its scope.
subchannels.active_motifs: adequacy and sufficiency `ح س ب:B003/m01`; universal person under negation `ء ح د:B002/m01`; numerous instances `ء ي ي:B007/m01`; signification `ق و ل:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sufficiency and universality set opposite boundaries: one asks whether the available amount reaches a threshold, while the other expands reference until no eligible person remains outside it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Action depends on counting, delimiting, possessing power, enduring constraint, and choosing after reflection.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:5-7 joins supposition, power, singularity, and unseen accountability.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Measure also governs astronomical calculation, medium quality, coordinated horse footfall, adequacy, and expansive quantification under negation.

parent_channels.name: Conflict, Peril, and Retribution

subchannels.name: Perilous Incursion and Exposure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person enters a danger whose terrain and consequences may overwhelm the entrant.
subchannels.active_motifs: rash entry into danger `ق ح م:B001/m01`; great road peril `ق ح م:B002/m01`; casting oneself into destruction `ه ل ك:B002/m01`; deadly waste or chasm `ه ل ك:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Incursion crosses the boundary between deliberation and exposure. Once entered, the dangerous route or chasm can no longer be treated as a distant possibility.

subchannels.name: Sword, Stick, and Close Combat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents close distance and strike with swords, sticks, or a club-like implement.
subchannels.active_motifs: dueling with swords and sticks `ب ل د:B011/m01`; courage and aid in combat `ن ج د:B003/m01`; striking-stick or bat `ق و ل:B008/m01`; hard central grip `ك ب د:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The combat scene combines bodily courage, held implement, and sustained proximity. The grip mediates force from the fighter into sword, stick, or club.

subchannels.name: Hostility, Feud, and Truce
subchannels.scene_or_process: Enmity takes hold between groups and is then suspended by an agreed ceasefire.
subchannels.active_motifs: deep hostility figured as black livers `ك ب د:B007/m01`; feud or enmity `ن و ر:B007/m01`; negotiated truce `ق س م:B008/m01`; companion-group alignment `ص ح ب:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Feud is a durable relation between aligned groups, not a single clash. Truce does not erase that relation but regulates it by suspending hostile action.

subchannels.name: Punishment, Retaliation, and Forced Restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offense is answered by punitive force, including detention, execution, or retaliatory payment.
subchannels.active_motifs: punishment after wrongdoing `ع ق ب:B007/m01`; retaliatory execution `ص ب ر:B012/m01`; forced detention for execution or oath `ص ب ر:B002/m01`; punishment becoming due `ح ل ل:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Retribution follows an ordered sequence: offense establishes liability, force restrains the offender, and punishment is carried out as the answering consequence.

subchannels.name: Captive, Asylum, and Protected Passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vulnerable entrant seeks protected status, while a captive awaits release from hostile control.
subchannels.active_motifs: asylum seeker under protection `ه د ي:B007/m01`; captive `ه د ي:B007/m02`; freeing a captive `ف ك ك:B002/m02`; grant of security `ء م ن:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Protection changes the legal meaning of movement. The asylum seeker crosses into safety by covenant, while the captive crosses out of coercion through release.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conflict exposes agents to danger, organized violence, hostility, restraint, and answering punishment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:11 presents perilous incursion, 90:13 a bound neck, and 90:20 terminal confinement in fire.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The conflict field includes sword-and-stick duels, blackened livers as enmity, ceasefire, forced oaths, retaliation, and protected asylum.

parent_channels.name: Body Core, Landmarks, and Orientation

subchannels.name: Liver, Lung, and Bodily Center
subchannels.scene_or_process: Internal organs occupy a central torso whose swelling or pain becomes externally legible.
subchannels.active_motifs: liver and its illness `ك ب د:B001/m01`; lung and its complaint `ر ء ي:B009/m01`; central mass `ك ب د:B003/m01`; protruding middle `ك ب د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The body is organized around a vulnerable core. Liver, lung, center, and bodily protrusion connect hidden organs to felt or visible signs of strain.

subchannels.name: Chest, Clavicle, and Necklace Site
subchannels.scene_or_process: The upper torso is read as a hollow framed by breastbone and clavicles and marked by where a necklace rests.
subchannels.active_motifs: chest and throat hollow `ب ل د:B002/m01`; clavicles and upper breast `ت ر ب:B005/m01`; necklace position `ت ر ب:B005/m02`; chest-centered submission `ب ل د:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Anatomy and ornament share one surface. The bones frame the chest, the necklace traces that frame, and the hand-to-chest gesture turns it into a site of embodied response.

subchannels.name: Jaw, Mouth, and Throat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Jaws open around the mouth while throat pressure regulates speech, food, breath, or restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: paired jaws `ف ك ك:B004/m01`; lips `ش ف ه:B001/m01`; throat seized in choking `ط ع م:B012/m01`; neck as bodily passage `ر ق ب:B004/m01`; head's resting place on the neck `س ك ن:B009/m02`; tongue as articulator `ل س ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The mouth is a shared passage for language, nourishment, and breath, set below the head where it rests on the neck. Jaw opening enables those functions; constriction at the throat reverses them.

subchannels.name: Heel, Tendon, and Weak Hock
subchannels.scene_or_process: Tendons hold the rear foot and ankle under tension, while looseness produces an unstable gait.
subchannels.active_motifs: hard tendon or bowstring sinew `ع ق ب:B001/m01`; heel and rear foot `ع ق ب:B002/m01`; loose hock or ankle `ح ل ل:B014/m01`; dislocated or relaxed joint `ف ك ك:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Stability depends on maintained tension. Tendon and heel carry the load, while loosened hock or separated joint converts support into weakness.

subchannels.name: Side, Flank, Fingertip, and Palm
subchannels.scene_or_process: The body is oriented by the side that faces the person, the flank at the waist, and the tactile extremity of hand and finger.
subchannels.active_motifs: human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`; flank and waist `ق ر ب:B015/m01`; fingertip `ت ر ب:B006/m01`; human figure or fingertip in the palm `ء ن س:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: These landmarks orient touch and proximity. Side and flank establish bodily direction, while palm and fingertip provide the fine point of contact with the surrounding world.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The body is mapped through central organs, chest structures, jaws, limbs, sides, and extremities.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:4 names `كَبَد`, 90:8-9 eyes, tongue, and lips, and 90:13 the neck-person.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Body mapping reaches bow grips, necklace sites, vessel sockets, animal hocks, eye-like notches, and the human-facing side of paired objects.

parent_channels.name: Appearance, Marking, and Ornament

subchannels.name: Brow, Facial Beauty, and Wide Eyes
subchannels.scene_or_process: Facial openness, proportion, and eye shape produce a recognizable ideal of beauty.
subchannels.active_motifs: clear space between the brows `ب ل د:B003/m01`; distributed facial beauty `ق س م:B001/m01`; wide and beautiful eyes `ع ي ن:B016/m01`; pleasing mirror appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Beauty is read through intervals and proportions: the clear brow frames the face, the eyes widen its expression, and the mirror makes the whole arrangement available for appraisal.

subchannels.name: Complexion, Tawny Redness, and Skin Change
subchannels.scene_or_process: Color in skin, hair, or hide identifies health, disease, and animal appearance.
subchannels.active_motifs: mixed white-red or dusty complexion `ح س ب:B009/m01`; tawny-red animal hue `ص ح ب:B008/m01`; skin mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`; pallor or disease resembling leprosy `ح س ب:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Color is diagnostic as well as decorative. Hue identifies the animal or person, while a changed patch can indicate disease or a lasting bodily event.

subchannels.name: Scar, Imprint, and Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contact leaves a visible mark that preserves the history of pressure, passage, or injury.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`; facial sign `ر ء ي:B006/m02`; heel-track and trail `ع ق ب:B002/m02`; eye-like notch `ع ي ن:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A trace converts past contact into present evidence. Scar, track, notch, and facial sign are all surfaces that retain an event after its cause has moved on.

subchannels.name: Necklace, Scabbard, and Crown
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worn and carried objects mark the body, protect weapons, and display rank.
subchannels.active_motifs: sword strap `ن ج د:B009/m01`; necklace resembling the sword-strap position `ن ج د:B009/m02`; necklace site on the chest `ت ر ب:B005/m02`; sword or knife scabbard `ق ر ب:B010/m01`; royal crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ornament and equipment share the body as their support. Necklace and baldric cross the chest, the scabbard encloses the weapon, and the crown makes authority visible at the head.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and objects become socially legible through proportion, color, trace, and adornment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the body parts of 90:8-9 and the visible-accountability frame of 90:7 provide the surface base.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Appearance includes an open brow, tawny animal color, skin disease, scars, sword straps, scabbards, crowns, and noble full siblings.

parent_channels.name: Animal Reproduction and Husbandry

subchannels.name: Mating, Pregnancy, and Approaching Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal enters mating heat, conceives, and develops visible signs as delivery approaches.
subchannels.active_motifs: female animal seeking the male `ج ع ل:B009/m01`; pregnancy becoming visible `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; nearness of animal delivery `ق ر ب:B012/m01`; pre-birth loosening and emaciation `ف ك ك:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reproduction is tracked through observable transitions: desire initiates mating, pregnancy enlarges the body, and loosening signals that birth is near.

subchannels.name: Delivery and Newborn Livestock
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young goat, lamb, or similar animal is delivered, separated from the mother, and recognized as newborn stock.
subchannels.active_motifs: newborn goat or lamb `ح ل ل:B010/m01`; animal delivery `و ل د:B003/m02`; body opening around birth `ف ك ك:B007/m02`; postpartum uterine trouble `ر ح م:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Delivery creates both a new dependent animal and a changed maternal body. Separation at birth is followed by care for the newborn and attention to postpartum complications.

subchannels.name: Udder, Duct, and Milk Descent
subchannels.scene_or_process: Milk moves through an udder or breast duct, sometimes descending with spring rather than immediate birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: milk outlet or duct `ح ل ل:B008/m02`; milk descending into the udder `ح ل ل:B009/m01`; milk taking flavor `ط ع م:B005/m02`; borrowed young used to induce milk `ل س ن:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lactation is a managed flow. The duct supplies the passage, seasonal or induced descent fills the udder, and flavor signals the resulting milk's condition.

subchannels.name: Pasture, Fodder, and Fattening
subchannels.scene_or_process: Suitable pasture keeps animals in place, feeds them heavily, and brings them into fat condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: pasture fitting the herd `و ص ي:B004/m01`; sustaining pasture `س ك ن:B010/m01`; fodder lodged as animals feed `ل ب د:B006/m01`; animal fatness `ط ع م:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene links environment to body condition. Fit pasture reduces the need to move, concentrated feeding fills the animal, and fatness records successful provision.

subchannels.name: Camel Condition, Waiting, and Weak Hock
subchannels.scene_or_process: A handler reads a camel's tractability, waiting behavior, age, hind-leg weakness, and bodily contamination.
subchannels.active_motifs: docile camel `ت ر ب:B009/m01`; camel waiting back from water `ر ق ب:B009/m01`; weak hock `ح ل ل:B014/m01`; precocious animal age `ق ح م:B005/m01`; dung-and-urine crust `ل ب د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Husbandry depends on close observation of behavior and body. Waiting at the trough, docility, age change, weak joints, and crusted hide each guide how the animal is handled.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Domestic animals are managed through mating, birth, lactation, pasture, body condition, and trained behavior.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the active senses are lexical extensions of roots appearing across 90:2-3, 90:7, 90:13-17.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The husbandry scene includes visible pregnancy, milk descending without birth, newborn goats, mating heat, fodder lodged in the throat, dung crust, weak hocks, and a camel waiting at water.

parent_channels.name: Hunting, Tracking, and Animal Pursuit

subchannels.name: Concealed Hunter and Hunting Blind
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter approaches under cover, waits behind a screen, and uses a tool that yields prey.
subchannels.active_motifs: stalking under animal cover `د ر ي:B003/m01`; hunting blind `ر ق ب:B011/m01`; hunting bow that yields game `ط ع م:B006/m01`; patient waiting `ر ق ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The hunt depends on delayed visibility. Cover and blind conceal the hunter, waiting holds the moment, and the hunting implement converts concealment into capture.

subchannels.name: Targeting, Raid, and Visual Appraisal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A target is identified by its sign, approached deliberately, and appraised before attack.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate targeting or raid `د ر ي:B002/m01`; targeting a person's visible sign `ء ي ي:B002/m01`; eye's appraisal of scale `ق ح م:B007/m01`; sensory sight `ر ء ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pursuit begins before physical approach. The hunter fixes identity through a sign, estimates the target, and only then commits to movement.

subchannels.name: Raptor, Standard, and Predatory Reach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raptor is trained or recognized as a hunting partner, while its elevated visibility also lends its form to a standard.
subchannels.active_motifs: hunting raptor `ع ق ب:B013/m01`; raptor-like banner `ع ق ب:B013/m02`; trained raptor that provides food `ط ع م:B006/m02`; raised visible standard `ر ء ي:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The raptor's height and striking reach support two connected roles: hunter and visible emblem. Both depend on a form recognized at distance.

subchannels.name: Heel, Track, and Pursuing Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A pursuer follows the rear trace left by a person, animal, or moving group.
subchannels.active_motifs: heel and following track `ع ق ب:B002/m02`; rear successor and dust trail `ر ق ب:B015/m02`; seeking news along a trace `ح س ب:B010/m01`; sensory sight `ر ء ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Tracking reads absence as evidence. Heel marks and trailing dust preserve direction, allowing the observer to reconstruct movement after the quarry has passed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Pursuit joins concealment, target selection, predatory tools, and the reading of tracks.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the lexical scene draws on seeing at 90:7-8, the difficult approach at 90:11-12, and the neck-release image at 90:13.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hunting connects a concealed archer, a pointed comb or horn, a raptor, a banner shaped by visibility, and the spoor left at the rear.

parent_channels.name: Plants, Fruit, and Cultivation

subchannels.name: Seed, Sapling, and Rooted Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed is covered in soil, a young plant emerges, and close roots establish it in place.
subchannels.active_motifs: seed covered by the cultivator `ك ف ر:B008/m01`; soil `ت ر ب:B001/m01`; sapling or plant `ت ر ب:B007/m01`; dwarf palm `ج ع ل:B006/m01`; close-rooted vegetation `و ص د:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cultivation begins in concealment. Seed is placed under soil, then the emerging plant establishes a compact root system that holds it to the ground.

subchannels.name: Grafting and Accepted Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A branch from one tree is joined to another and succeeds only if the host accepts the connection.
subchannels.active_motifs: grafting a branch `ط ع م:B010/m01`; joining one thing to another `و ص ي:B001/m01`; close-rooted attachment `و ص د:B004/m01`; receptivity to reform `ط ع م:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The graft is a precise model of successful relation: connection is made, the host receives it, and continuity is proven by new growth.

subchannels.name: Ripening Fruit and Protective Sheath
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fruit develops flavor while a sheath protects it until maturity.
subchannels.active_motifs: fruit ripening and acquiring flavor `ط ع م:B005/m01`; fruit or palm sheath `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; sour red-seeded fruit `ص ب ر:B009/m01`; fruiting tree `ج ع ل:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Maturation joins enclosure and sensory change. The sheath covers the developing fruit; ripeness is recognized when flavor and visible seed or color emerge.

subchannels.name: Yellowing, Withering, and Dry Stem
subchannels.scene_or_process: A plant passes from fruiting into yellow leaf, dry stem, and remaining trace.
subchannels.active_motifs: yellowing and drying plant `ع ق ب:B015/m01`; dry plant remainder `ع ق ب:B011/m03`; fruit sheath opening or drying `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; sour fruit nearing dry maturity `ص ب ر:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Withering is a temporal consequence visible in plant matter. Color fades, the stem hardens, and the dry remainder records the completed growth cycle.

subchannels.name: Flower, Fragrance, and Camphor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A tree flowers and releases a fragrance that is gathered or applied as perfume.
subchannels.active_motifs: tree blossom `ن و ر:B004/m01`; camphor perfume `ك ف ر:B011/m01`; camphor plant `ك ف ر:B011/m03`; perfumed coating `خ ل ق:B010/m01`; flowing spring `ع ي ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Flowering makes scent available; camphor and perfumed coating preserve and transfer it. The spring-source image adds a second mode of fragrance emerging from a hidden origin.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Cultivation joins seed, rooted attachment, ripening, withering, and flowering fragrance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; plant senses extend roots occurring at 90:13-20, especially release, feeding, counsel, consequence, covering, and fire/light.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The plant network includes graft acceptance, an eye-speck analogy, close-rooted growth, dwarf palms, tamarind-like sour fruit, fruit sheaths, seed covering, and camphor.

parent_channels.name: Water, Vessels, and Filtration

subchannels.name: Spring and Visible Source
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water emerges from a source and becomes visible as a flowing spring.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing spring `ع ي ن:B006/m01`; spring associated with camphor `ك ف ر:B011/m02`; visible disclosure `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; nearby water `ق ر ب:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: A hidden source declares itself through flowing visibility. Nearness matters because the spring converts remote need into accessible water.

subchannels.name: Waterskin, Leak, and Casing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is carried in a skin whose thin point may leak and whose outer casing protects it.
subchannels.active_motifs: waterskin container `ق ر ب:B009/m01`; leaking aperture in skin `ع ي ن:B007/m01`; sewn casing around a waterskin `ل ب د:B004/m01`; hide retaining hair `ص ح ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The vessel is an assembly of hide, seam, casing, and vulnerable aperture. Its purpose is defeated by leakage, so carrying water depends on maintaining the integrity of every layer.

subchannels.name: Water Surface, Algae, and Beetle Habitat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Standing water develops a surface growth and supports small creatures within it.
subchannels.active_motifs: algae covering water `ص ح ب:B007/m01`; water crowded with beetles `ج ع ل:B008/m01`; compacted surface layer `ل ب د:B001/m02`; still water or calm surface `س ك ن:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The water body becomes a layered habitat. Stillness permits algae to spread, compact surface matter forms, and beetles inhabit the resulting environment.

subchannels.name: Strainer, Vessel, and Residue
subchannels.scene_or_process: Liquid is poured through a strainer into a vessel, leaving sediment or residue behind.
subchannels.active_motifs: strainer and receiving vessel `ن ج د:B011/m01`; cooking or liquid vessel `ق د ر:B007/m01`; vessel brim and sides `ص ب ر:B004/m02`; physical sediment residue `ع ق ب:B011/m02`; thickened drink `ك ب د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Filtration separates flow from remainder. The strainer directs usable liquid into the vessel, its brim marks fullness, and thickness or residue identifies what the filtering process retains.

subchannels.name: Rock Basin, Well, and Retained Rain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A natural or built depression collects rain and holds it against stone and earth.
subchannels.active_motifs: rain-holding rock hollow `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; recently dug well `خ ل ق:B011/m02`; old ground-level basin `ب ل د:B010/m02`; hard rock and gravel `ص ب ر:B005/m01`; projecting well stone `ع ق ب:B012/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Retention converts terrain into a vessel. Hollow, stone rim, and ground-level basin cooperate to keep rain from immediately escaping.

subchannels.name: Night Journey to Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: People and animals travel urgently toward a watering place and carry water away in skins.
subchannels.active_motifs: night approach to water `ق ر ب:B008/m01`; waterskin `ق ر ب:B009/m01`; portable travel gear `ح ل ل:B013/m01`; camel waiting at the crowded source `ر ق ب:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Water organizes movement before and after arrival. Urgent approach brings the herd to the source, waiting regulates access, and the filled skin extends the water's reach beyond the site.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water is found, carried, leaked, surfaced, filtered, and retained through a set of natural and crafted containers.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the lexical water scenes are anchored mainly by eye, nearness, dwelling, accumulated material, and creation roots.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Water appears as a spring, a leaking skin, algae on a surface, a beetle-filled pool, a strainer, a rock basin, and a night journey toward a watering place.

parent_channels.name: Cooking, Taste, Medicine, and Surface Treatment

subchannels.name: Pot, Heat, and Cooked Stew
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is cooked in a pot, removed from heat with a cloth, and leaves a thick residue.
subchannels.active_motifs: cooking pot and stew `ق د ر:B007/m01`; cloth used to lower a hot pot `ج ع ل:B007/m01`; pot residue `ع ق ب:B011/m02`; thickened drink or liquid `ك ب د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The cooking assembly has container, heat-handling tool, changing contents, and remainder. Thickness and residue record the transformation after the pot is removed from the fire.

subchannels.name: Taste, Flavor, and Practical Value
subchannels.scene_or_process: A substance or person is tested by taste, flavor, or the capacity to yield useful value.
subchannels.active_motifs: tasting and eating `ط ع م:B001/m01`; recognizable flavor `ط ع م:B005/m03`; intelligence and practical value `ط ع م:B008/m01`; quality or excellence `ع ي ن:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Taste becomes a model of discernment. Flavor identifies mature food, while "having taste" extends sensory discrimination into intelligence, worth, and capacity for reform.

subchannels.name: Child Dosing and Bitter Medicine
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caregiver opens a child's mouth and places a measured medicinal substance inside.
subchannels.active_motifs: child patient `ف ك ك:B009/m01`; medicine placed in the mouth `ف ك ك:B009/m02`; bitter aloe medicine `ص ب ر:B008/m01`; bounded quantity `ق د ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Treatment joins caregiver, patient, dose, and entry route. Bitterness explains resistance, while measured mouth delivery ensures the medicine reaches the child.

subchannels.name: Throat Seizure and Choking
subchannels.scene_or_process: An assailant seizes the throat and compresses the breathing passage between neck and jaws.
subchannels.active_motifs: throat as the seized point `ط ع م:B012/m01`; forceful compression `ط ع م:B012/m02`; paired jaws `ف ك ك:B004/m01`; neck as bodily passage `ر ق ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Choking is a localized coercive action. The grip fixes on the throat, compression closes the passage, and the surrounding neck and jaw anatomy define the vulnerable point.

subchannels.name: Mouth-to-Mouth Contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two mouths meet in reciprocal contact or a kiss.
subchannels.active_motifs: mouth-to-mouth insertion or kiss `ط ع م:B013/m01`; lips as contact surface `ش ف ه:B001/m01`; paired jaws `ف ك ك:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The interaction is defined by reciprocal oral contact. Lips supply the exposed surface, the paired jaws frame each mouth, and the contact itself distinguishes the scene from speech or forced throat pressure.

subchannels.name: Kohl, Tattoo, and Imprinted Skin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Smoke or pigment is applied to a punctured or marked surface to create kohl or a lasting tattoo.
subchannels.active_motifs: tattoo smoke or kohl pigment `ن و ر:B008/m01`; bodily mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`; eye-like puncture or notch `ع ي ن:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pigment enters through a deliberately altered surface. Puncture receives the material, smoke or kohl fixes color, and the resulting mark persists as a visible trace.

subchannels.name: Lime, Oil, and Perfumed Coating
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prepared substance is spread over skin or another surface to remove hair, soften, or perfume it.
subchannels.active_motifs: applied lime or depilatory paste `ن و ر:B009/m01`; sesame oil `ح ل ل:B015/m01`; perfumed coating `خ ل ق:B010/m01`; smooth prepared surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: These treatments act by spreading a material film. Oil softens, lime strips, perfume scents, and polishing prepares the surface to receive the application evenly.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Substances are transformed, tested, ingested, or applied through heat, taste, mouth, and bodily surface.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the lexical processes extend the feeding root at 90:14, opening at 90:13, bodily form at 90:4, and fire at 90:20.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The material scene includes a pot-lifting cloth, stew residue, bitter aloe, medicine placed in a child's mouth, choking, kissing, tattoo smoke, lime paste, and sesame oil.

parent_channels.name: Textiles, Hides, and Furnishing

subchannels.name: Felt, Wool, and Hair-Retaining Hide
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hair or wool is retained, compacted, and worked into felt, patches, or a protected hide.
subchannels.active_motifs: felted wool and patched material `ل ب د:B001/m01`; hide retaining hair or fleece `ص ح ب:B006/m01`; compacting layers `ل ب د:B001/m02`; animal hair and wool contrast `ل ب د:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The process begins with fiber still attached to hide or gathered loose, then uses pressure and layering to produce a dense, durable material.

subchannels.name: Garment, Undergarment, and Worn Cloth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is assembled into layered clothing, worn next to the body, and eventually loses its nap through use.
subchannels.active_motifs: garment ensemble `ح ل ل:B007/m01`; girl's undergarment `ء ص د:B003/m01`; cloth covering armor or a weapon `ك ف ر:B001/m01`; worn cloth stripped of nap `خ ل ق:B009/m01`; first fold of cloth `ق س م:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 90:2 `حِلٌّ` (ح ل ل); 90:19 `كَفَرُوا` (ك ف ر); 90:4 `خَلَقْنَا` (خ ل ق); 90:1 `أُقْسِمُ` (ق س م); no independent surface occurrence for ء ص د
subchannels.synthesis: Folding and layering turn cloth into clothing or a protective covering. Proximity to the body distinguishes the undergarment, cloth can cover carried armor, and wear records continued use over time.

subchannels.name: Fiber Preparation and Twisting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Palm fiber is combed or stripped, divided into strands, and prepared for twisting.
subchannels.active_motifs: preparing fiber into strands `ل س ن:B009/m01`; tongue-shaped narrow strand `ل س ن:B004/m01`; compacted fiber `ل ب د:B001/m02`; comb or dressing tool `د ر ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Fiber work changes an irregular mass into aligned, narrow elements. Combing and division prepare strands whose tongue-like shape permits twisting into cord.

subchannels.name: Cushion, Curtain, and Food Mat
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dwelling is furnished with cushions, hangings, and a broad layer placed beneath food.
subchannels.active_motifs: small cushion `ح س ب:B008/m01`; furnishing a house with textiles `ن ج د:B008/m01`; food mat or broad wafer `ص ب ر:B011/m01`; felt floor covering `ل ب د:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Furnishing converts prepared textile into an inhabited interior. Floor layer, cushion, hanging, and food mat organize rest, privacy, and eating within the home.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Fibers and skins are prepared, layered, worn, cased, or arranged to furnish bodies and dwellings.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the lexical scene grows from compacted abundance at 90:6, speech-organ roots at 90:9, and division at 90:1.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Textile work includes felt, patched cloth, hair-retaining hide, a girl's undergarment, worn fabric, prepared palm fiber, first folds, cushions, curtains, and a food mat.

parent_channels.name: Light, Weather, and the Sky

subchannels.name: Light, Fire, and Brand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire emits light, provides a visible focus, and can leave a brand on an animal.
subchannels.active_motifs: illumination `ن و ر:B001/m01`; burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; fire-brand mark `ن و ر:B002/m02`; hearth-like solace `س ك ن:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Fire joins visibility and contact. At a distance it illuminates and comforts; applied to the body it becomes a lasting identifying brand.
