subchannels.name: Beacon, Boundary Marker, and Tower
subchannels.scene_or_process: A high visible marker defines land and guides travelers.
subchannels.active_motifs: road beacon or minaret `ن و ر:B005/m01`; elevated clear route `ن ج د:B001/m01`; evident guide `ن ج د:B002/m01`; raised lookout `ر ق ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Elevation and light cooperate to make a marker legible. The beacon both locates a boundary and supplies orientation along the route.

subchannels.name: Sun Disk, Noon Heat, and Daylight
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sun's visible disk governs a hot daytime interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: solar disk `ع ي ن:B008/m01`; noon heat `ق س م:B002/m01`; daylight span `ي و م:B001/m01`; central sun position `ك ب د:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Disk, central position, heat, and day form one solar scene. The sun's location supplies both the visible measure of time and the felt intensity of noon.

subchannels.name: Lunar Mansion and Round Star Cluster
subchannels.scene_or_process: Celestial objects occupy named stations and are counted or recognized by shape.
subchannels.active_motifs: lunar mansion and sky void `ب ل د:B004/m01`; round star cluster `ف ك ك:B008/m01`; astronomical reckoning `ح س ب:B001/m02`; opposing star in rising and setting `ر ق ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Astronomy organizes the sky through station, opposition, number, and visible shape. A void becomes a mansion because recurring celestial positions make it identifiable.

subchannels.name: Rain, Layered Cloud, and Catchment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloud gathers in layers, releases persistent rain, and fills a stone catchment.
subchannels.active_motifs: persistent rain or rain-cloud `ع ي ن:B010/m01`; layered white cloud `ص ب ر:B010/m01`; rain-holding rock hollow `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; stilling of rain or wind `س ك ن:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The atmospheric process has accumulation, release, reception, and cessation. Stacked cloud supplies rain, the hollow retains it, and stillness marks the end of the weather event.

subchannels.name: Drought, Migration, and Winter Cold
subchannels.scene_or_process: Failed rain and severe temperature expose people and animals, forcing movement toward relief.
subchannels.active_motifs: rainless land or year `ه ل ك:B005/m01`; drought driving nomads to settled land `ق ح م:B003/m01`; severe winter cold `ص ب ر:B007/m01`; famine hunger `س غ ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Climate becomes social pressure. Drought removes pasture and food, cold increases exposure, and migration carries affected people from open land toward settled provision.

subchannels.name: Celestial Cover and Darkness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloud, night, or sunset spreads across the sky and hides a previously visible light.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud or celestial covering `ك ف ر:B001/m02`; dark night or sunset as enveloping cover `ك ف ر:B002/m01`; layered cloud `ص ب ر:B010/m01`; solar disk `ع ي ن:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment is an atmospheric process: cloud accumulates, darkness or sunset spreads, and the solar or stellar light disappears beneath the covering layer.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Celestial and atmospheric phenomena make direction, time, heat, water, and exposure visible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:20 names fire, 90:10 presents visible routes, and 90:14 names a severe day of hunger.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sky includes a road beacon, lunar mansion, round star cluster, noon heat, persistent rain, stacked white cloud, rainless cloud, winter cold, and drought-driven migration.

parent_channels.name: Time, Recurrence, and Consequence

subchannels.name: Day, Duration, and Event
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded day can expand into an indefinite duration or stand for a severe event.
subchannels.active_motifs: daylight unit `ي و م:B001/m01`; temporal duration `ي و م:B002/m01`; event or calamity `ي و م:B003/m01`; occurrence in time `ك و ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: "Day" supplies a temporal container whose scale changes with use. It can mark ordinary daylight, an extended span, or the event that defines the span.

subchannels.name: First, Sunday, and Calendar Order
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named day occupies the first position in an ordered weekly sequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: first or Sunday `ء ح د:B004/m01`; single day unit `ي و م:B001/m01`; counted one `ء ح د:B003/m01`; solar day `ع ي ن:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The calendar scene combines ordinal position, counted unity, and solar duration. Sunday is both a name and the first member of a repeating series.

subchannels.name: Waiting and Imminence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A watcher pauses while an expected arrival or event draws near.
subchannels.active_motifs: waiting and delay `ء ي ي:B001/m01`; watchful expectation `ر ق ب:B001/m01`; imminent time `ق ر ب:B002/m01`; delayed movement `ي ت م:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Waiting measures the interval between present lack and expected arrival. Imminence shortens that interval, while delay prolongs it despite the object's nearness.

subchannels.name: Succession, Repetition, and Connected Cycles
subchannels.scene_or_process: One action or occupant follows another, and the sequence returns in repeated cycles.
subchannels.active_motifs: succession and alternation `ع ق ب:B005/m01`; repeated action `ع ق ب:B009/m01`; joining night to day `و ص ي:B001/m02`; successor at the rear `ر ق ب:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Continuity can be linear or cyclical. A successor fills the previous position, while repeated work, prayer, pasture, or day-night connection makes return part of the order.

subchannels.name: Ending, Aftereffect, and Remaining Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: An action reaches its end and leaves a result, residue, illness, or condition behind.
subchannels.active_motifs: ending and consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`; residue and aftereffect `ع ق ب:B011/m01`; destruction or disappearance `ه ل ك:B001/m01`; bad resulting state `ك و ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Outcome is read through what remains after the initiating act is over. Residue, illness, bad state, or disappearance gives consequence a concrete temporal signature.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Events are situated in spans, awaited, repeated, succeeded, and known by what remains after them.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:14 names a day, 90:17 marks a subsequent state, and 90:18-20 present final group outcomes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal order reaches Sunday, waiting in place, repeated prayer or pasture, alternating successors, pot residue, lingering illness, and a bad overnight state.

parent_channels.name: Unity, Individuality, and Presence

subchannels.name: Absolute Unity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A referent is asserted as one without division or peer.
subchannels.active_motifs: unity and singular oneness `ء ح د:B001/m01`; offspring as one member `و ل د:B001/m01`; selfsame essence `ع ي ن:B013/m01`; complete visible form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Unity identifies a whole as itself. Formation supplies coherence, essence secures identity, and numerical one excludes division within the named referent.

subchannels.name: Anyone Under Negation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Negation expands from one possible person to every person who could occupy the role.
subchannels.active_motifs: universal person in negative scope `ء ح د:B002/m01`; no human present `ء ن س:B001/m02`; no present eye or household member `ع ي ن:B017/m02`; exhaustive idiom "in every case" `ه ل ك:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The grammatical singular becomes semantically exhaustive. By denying even one eligible witness, the expression denies the entire class.

subchannels.name: Solitude and Unique Object
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or object stands apart from companions or lacks any comparable peer.
subchannels.active_motifs: acting or arriving alone `ء ح د:B005/m01`; unique pearl, poem, or isolated thing `ي ت م:B002/m01`; remote or cut-off place `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; remaining without spouse `ي ت م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Solitude can be deprivation or distinction. The same separation that leaves a person without relation can make an object rare because no equal stands beside it.

subchannels.name: Human Presence, Self, and Possessor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human appears as a present self who possesses attributes, relations, or companions.
subchannels.active_motifs: human presence opposed to wildness or spirit `ء ن س:B001/m01`; one's own self or intimate `ء ن س:B006/m01`; essence of the thing `ع ي ن:B013/m01`; possessor characterized by relation `ذ و و:B001/m01`; present people or household `ع ي ن:B017/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Presence joins ontology to social grammar. The self is identifiable as an essence, appears among people, and is further specified by what or whom it possesses.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons and things are distinguished as one, any, solitary, present, or self-identical.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:4 names humanity, 90:5 and 90:7 use `أَحَد`, and 90:17-19 sort persons into present communities.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Identity reaches unique pearls and poems, an image in the pupil, the essence of an object, a confidant as "one's own person," and universal reference under negation.

parent_channels.name: Direction, Regional Affiliation, and Portent

subchannels.name: Right and Left Orientation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or group is assigned to the right or left side of an oriented field.
subchannels.active_motifs: right hand and right side `ي م ن:B002/m01`; left side `ش ء م:B001/m01`; human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`; directional route `ه د ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Right and left are relational positions rather than isolated labels. A facing body and a chosen route establish the frame in which each side acquires meaning.

subchannels.name: Blessing and Ill Omen
subchannels.scene_or_process: Directional sides become signs of favorable or harmful outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: blessing and good fortune `ي م ن:B001/m01`; ill omen `ش ء م:B003/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Portent reads orientation prospectively. A side or sign is interpreted as announcing the kind of consequence toward which the person is moving.

subchannels.name: Yemen, Syria, and Ghassan Affiliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or group is identified by regional direction, country, or tribal affiliation.
subchannels.active_motifs: Yemen and affiliation to it `ي م ن:B005/m01`; Syria and movement toward it `ش ء م:B002/m01`; Ghassan clan name `ص ب ر:B016/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Direction becomes social identity when regions supply names for people, clans, and offices. Yemen, Syria, Ghassan, and the Himyarite title locate affiliation within a geographic field.

subchannels.name: Vanguard, Rear, and Right-Side Burial
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving body is oriented from leading front to following heel, and a dead body is finally laid on its right.
subchannels.active_motifs: vanguard or front point `ه د ي:B003/m01`; heel and rear `ع ق ب:B002/m01`; death laid on the right side `ي م ن:B007/m01`; burial soil `ت ر ب:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Orientation persists across movement and death. The front leads, the heel follows, and burial fixes the body's final side against the soil.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Orientation assigns sides, routes, regions, and moral or auspicious value.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:10 gives two directed roads, while 90:18-19 contrast right and left groupings.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Direction reaches Yemen and Syria, Ghassan affiliation, vanguard and heel, burial on the right side, blessing, ill omen, and regional rulership.

parent_channels.name: Governance, Worth, and Public Standing

subchannels.name: Chief, Courtier, and Royal Intimate
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler or chief exercises standing through trusted people admitted near the seat of authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: steadfast chief `ح ل ل:B012/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`; favored courtier `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; crowned ruler `ك ف ر:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rank is organized by controlled nearness. The chief occupies the center, courtiers gain privileged access, and title or crown renders the hierarchy publicly visible.

subchannels.name: Lineage, Honor, and Noble Siblings
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's standing is inherited and recognized through ancestors, deeds, and full sibling lineage.
subchannels.active_motifs: ancestral honor and memorable deeds `ح س ب:B004/m01`; nobles of the community `ع ي ن:B015/m01`; collateral inherited distinction `ر ق ب:B013/m01`; surviving descendants `ع ق ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Public honor is a temporal social asset. Ancestors establish it, siblings define its line, and descendants or collateral heirs carry it onward.

subchannels.name: Administration, Supervision, and Objection
subchannels.scene_or_process: An official inspects conduct, manages public affairs, and answers challenges to a judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: practical administration and moral oversight `ح س ب:B006/m01`; authoritative ruling `ق و ل:B010/m01`; reconsideration and objection `ع ق ب:B008/m01`; watching officer `ر ق ب:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Governance is a cycle of inspection, decision, and reconsideration. Supervision gathers the matter, ruling acts on it, and objection tests whether the decision will stand.

subchannels.name: Excellence, Principal, and Medium Quality
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods or persons are ranked as choice, principal, or intermediate in quality.
subchannels.active_motifs: best or choice item `ع ي ن:B014/m01`; choice property `ر ق ب:B012/m01`; medium quality and price `ق ر ب:B016/m02`; accumulated property `م و ل:B001/m01`; social rank or standing `ك و ن:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Valuation separates the best item from ordinary property, distinguishes the principal asset from an approximate middle quality, and extends assessed worth into public standing.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communities distinguish leaders, administrators, honored lineages, and valued persons or property.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the accountability claims of 90:5-7 and group designations of 90:18-19 provide the social frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Standing includes a steadfast chief, royal intimates, a Himyarite title, inherited honor, full siblings, municipal supervision, best-quality goods, and principal capital.

parent_channels.name: Motion, Transport, and Gait

subchannels.name: Horse Pace and Coordinated Footfall
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rider prompts a horse into a measured gait whose hind and forefeet coordinate.
subchannels.active_motifs: paced horse run `ق ر ب:B014/m01`; muzzle area used to cue running `ط ع م:B009/m01`; coordinated foot placement `ق د ر:B006/m02`; favored prepared mount `ق ر ب:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Training regulates speed through bodily cues and repeated placement. The result is neither uncontrolled flight nor stillness but a measured, usable pace.

subchannels.name: Supported Sway and Composed Bearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A weak or stylized walker sways, leans on companions, and may recover a calm bearing.
subchannels.active_motifs: supported swaying walk `ه د ي:B008/m01`; broken or coquettish sway `ه ل ك:B003/m01`; calm, unhurried bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; companion support `ص ح ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Gait reveals both condition and social support. Sway may signal weakness or display; leaning companions stabilize it, and composed bearing restores directional control.

subchannels.name: Dislodging, Relocation, and Adherence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person, herd, or object is moved from a place, while another remains attached and refuses displacement.
subchannels.active_motifs: dislodging people or camels `ح ل ل:B011/m01`; separation from attachment `ف ك ك:B003/m01`; continued persistence `ف ك ك:B003/m02`; staying and clinging `ل ب د:B003/m01`; settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Relocation is understood against resistance to movement. Dislodging breaks place-attachment, while clinging and residence preserve it.

subchannels.name: Camel Travel and Portable Equipment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Camels carry people and gear across distance toward a sought destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: striking camel livers in travel `ك ب د:B008/m01`; portable encampment equipment `ح ل ل:B013/m01`; effective progress on an errand `ن ج د:B004/m01`; direction and travel manner `ه د ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Long movement depends on animal power, portable equipment, and maintained direction. The journey is measured by purposeful progress rather than mere displacement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement is controlled through pace, support, equipment, relocation, and the body's relation to the ground.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the routes and ascent of 90:10-12 supply the surface movement frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Motion includes a horse's coordinated footfall, muzzle-prompted run, supported swaying, coquettish gait, camel travel for knowledge, dislodging an encampment, and persistent adhesion.

parent_channels.name: Compliance, Hesitation, and Loss of Agency

subchannels.name: Docility, Training, and Obedience
subchannels.scene_or_process: A previously difficult person or animal yields to guidance and follows another's direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: submission after difficulty `ص ح ب:B003/m01`; docile camel `ت ر ب:B009/m01`; bowed compliance `ك ف ر:B014/m01`; directed conduct `ه د ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Training converts resistance into coordinated following. The body lowers or yields, and guidance becomes effective because the subject now accepts direction.

subchannels.name: Bewilderment and Abased Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distress removes orientation, causing a person to circle, lower the body, and submit.
subchannels.active_motifs: confusion with hand to chest `ب ل د:B005/m01`; circling in the wilderness `ه ل ك:B010/m01`; poverty and abasement `س ك ن:B006/m01`; submissive state `ك و ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Loss of direction becomes loss of agency. Circling cannot produce progress, distress lowers posture, and submission replaces chosen movement.

subchannels.name: Dullness, Lag, and Delayed Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: Weak judgment or heavy motion prevents timely progress and delays the good expected from a person.
subchannels.active_motifs: dullness and lag `ب ل د:B007/m01`; slow weak person `ه د ي:B009/m01`; loose judgment `ف ك ك:B006/m01`; delayed progress `ي ت م:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lag joins cognition and movement. The person neither judges firmly nor advances promptly, so intended action arrives late or not at all.

subchannels.name: Skittish Withdrawal and Chaste Refusal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or animal recoils from an approach and preserves distance through refusal.
subchannels.active_motifs: skittish or chaste withdrawal `ن و ر:B006/m01`; coercion that drives obedience into disobedience `ك ف ر:B007/m01`; retreat on the heel `ع ق ب:B003/m01`; separation from attachment `ف ك ك:B003/m01`; guarded waiting `ر ق ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Withdrawal is an active boundary-making response, whether self-chosen or induced by coercion. The subject turns back, breaks contact, and watches from distance rather than continuing in the prior obedience.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Agency can be yielded willingly, weakened by dullness, suspended by confusion, or withdrawn through skittish avoidance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 90:16-17 contrast abasement with settled belief and action, while 90:18-19 assign persons to opposed group outcomes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel reaches trained animals, bowed posture, circling bewilderment, delayed charity, loose judgment, chastity figured as skittishness, and heavy weak movement.

parent_channels.name: S1. Bow Assembly from Sinew, Grip, and Point
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A bow is assembled from tension-bearing sinew, a thick central grip, and a pointed component used to direct the shot.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tendon or bowstring `ع ق ب:B001/m01`; thick bow grip `ك ب د:B004/m01`; pointed horn or comb `د ر ي:B004/m01`; arrowhead or leading point `ه د ي:B003/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The bow scene is mechanically complete: sinew stores tension, the central grip receives the archer's force, and the pointed leading element gives that force direction.

parent_channels.name: S2. Ostrich Nest, Egg, and Chick
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An ostrich lays in a ground nest and produces a chick from the egg left there.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ostrich nest and egg `ب ل د:B012/m01`; ostrich chick `ج ع ل:B010/m01`; animal birth `و ل د:B003/m02`; ground dust `ت ر ب:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene joins ground hollow, egg, birth, and young animal. Unlike an enclosure built to hold livestock, the nest is a reproductive site made in open earth.

parent_channels.name: S3. Allotted Share and Gambling Supervision
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Shares are divided under an overseer, with a designated arrow and principal stake governing the allocation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: division into allotted shares `ق س م:B003/m01`; gambling overseer and third arrow `ر ق ب:B006/m01`; choice property `ر ق ب:B012/m01`; unmeasured food or goods heap `ص ب ر:B011/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The allocation scene has stake, portions, device, and supervisor. Division converts the common heap into individual outcomes, while the overseer and arrow regulate how those outcomes are assigned.

parent_channels.name: S4. Stick-and-Ball Contest
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A player uses a dedicated stick to strike the game object in a compact contest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: striking stick or bat `ق و ل:B008/m01`; struck game-piece `ق و ل:B008/m02`; close stick combat analogy `ب ل د:B011/m02`; effective power `ق د ر:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The branch image contains a complete recreational mechanism: implement, struck object, player action, and controlled force. Its resemblance to combat remains secondary to the game operation.

parent_channels.name: S5. Smith, Knife, and Carried Blade
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A smith produces a blade that is carried by strap and sheath and used to still an animal in slaughter.
parent_channels.active_motifs: smith affiliation `ه ل ك:B007/m01`; knife that stills the slaughtered animal `س ك ن:B007/m01`; sword strap `ن ج د:B009/m01`; blade scabbard `ق ر ب:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Craft, carriage, enclosure, and use form a single blade lifecycle. The smith makes the implement, strap and scabbard secure it in travel, and the knife's action ends the animal's movement.
